sara (EngRuntime): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — question about kernel-v4 + dynamic batching: who owns the default batch-size per route (hosted vs dedicated)? we need this nailed before canary.

raj (VP Eng): eng-runtime owns the batch-size defaults and perf profiles. eng-platform owns enforcement/route-level overrides. we'll favor latency-aware defaults but publish explicit profiles.

lee (Eng SRE): for the canary I recommend locking to a fixed batch=8 to reduce variance. I can run the canary with that override.

maple (Product): product ask: please document the defaults we will show customers. hosted should default to batch=4 to reduce multi-tenant tail. dedicated can be batch=8.

toni (EngOps): I'll add an ops checklist item to verify route defaults and overrides during rollout. @sara can you drop the expected perf numbers so I can include them?

sara (EngRuntime): perf targets (dedicated, batch=8, 1k seq): p50 ~60ms, p95 ~220ms, p99 <=380ms. hosted (batch=4, 1k): p99 <=450ms. I'll post the perf matrix link after the final run.

lee (Eng SRE): plan: run `./tools/deploy_canary --override-batch=8 --region=eu-west-1` tomorrow 08:00 PT, monitor p99 + error_rate. I'll post logs and flamegraphs.
